title: The Scarf Finished with Your Colors
youtube_title: The Scarf Finished with Your Colors | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Chioma notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a scarf finished in the colors you had pointed at once. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Chioma does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
